summary.name: Claude God
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source native macOS menu bar app that tracks Claude AI rate limits, quotas, and Claude Code costs in real time using your existing Claude Pro, Max, or Team login.
keywords: claude api usage without api key
use_cases: Check how much Claude rate limit is left before hitting Opus limits
Track daily and monthly Claude Code spending by model
See when Claude session or weekly quotas reset
Review past Claude Code sessions and token usage
Export daily cost and token data to CSV
summary.what_it_does: Claude God displays Claude usage as three concentric ring gauges in the macOS menu bar, covering session, weekly, per-model (Sonnet, Opus) and API dollar quotas. It shows live countdown timers for when each quota resets and changes the menu bar color green, orange, or red based on usage, with optional threshold alerts. Cost analytics break down Claude Code spending per day, week, and month by model (Opus, Sonnet, Haiku) with 30-day trend charts. A session timeline lets you browse past Claude Code sessions by project, time range, cost, and model, and data can be exported as CSV or copied to the clipboard.
notable: Reads existing claude login OAuth credentials, so no API key is needed
Native SwiftUI app with no Electron and no external dependencies; universal binary
MIT-licensed open source with zero telemetry, and credentials stay on the Mac
Six-tab popover covering Usage, Analytics, Timeline, ROI, and Extensions
caveats: Requires a Claude subscription that supports Claude Code (Pro, Max, or Team) and running claude login first
Page does not state whether the app remains actively maintained beyond the listed version v2.24.3
